description: the loader rejects literal keys where the schema is free-form
source:
apiVersion: sirb/v1alpha1
kind: Tool
metadata: {name: gh}
spec:
  type: http
  description: GitHub search
  inputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      token: {type: string, default: ghp_FAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKEFAKE}
  http: {method: GET, url: https://api.github.com/search/code}
